strings.zh: 这个愤怒湖是曾经{NEWLINE}暴鲤龙暴乱时候留下的坑穴,{CLEAR}积蓄了雨水后就变成了湖。{SCROLL}据说这是我爷爷的爷爷的再{NEWLINE}爷爷的时候的事了。{SCROLL}之前这里是{NEWLINE}能钓到很精神的{CLEAR}鲤鱼王的湖……{CLEAR}但最近湖中的精灵们都很没精神。{SCROLL}这到底是怎么一回事啊？
strings.en: The Lake of Rage is actually a crater{NEWLINE}left by rampaging Gyarados long ago.{CLEAR}It filled up with rainwater and{CLEAR}became a lake.{SCROLL}They say that was back in my grandpa’s{NEWLINE}grandpa’s grandpa’s day.{SCROLL}You used to be able to catch lively{NEWLINE}Magikarp here... But lately the Pokémon{CLEAR}in the lake have no energy at all.{SCROLL}What on earth is going on?
strings.notes: US 0628/0; modernised from US 0628#0 | RV048: omission: US line dropped the listless lake Pokémon and the question; generations per zh (D-1993)

strings.zh: 是不是那些穿白衣的研究员{NEWLINE}来这搅和才把湖{CLEAR}弄得这么奇怪了？
strings.en: Did those researchers in white coats{NEWLINE}come and mess around here? Is that{CLEAR}why the lake has gotten so strange?
strings.notes: US ‘men wearing black’ replaced: the hack says researchers in white coats.

strings.zh: 啊呀！愤怒湖{NEWLINE}又像从前那样可以钓到{CLEAR}优质的鲤鱼王了！{SCROLL}这样一来,就又能实现{NEWLINE}找到世界第一大的{CLEAR}鲤鱼王的梦想了。{SCROLL}你如果也有鲤鱼王的话{NEWLINE}带过来给我看看吧！
strings.en: Whoa! You can catch fine{NEWLINE}Magikarp at the Lake of Rage{CLEAR}again, just like before!{SCROLL}Now I can chase my dream of finding{NEWLINE}the world’s biggest Magikarp again.{SCROLL}If you have a Magikarp too,{NEWLINE}bring it over and show me!
strings.notes: US Rod request replaced: zh asks to be shown a Magikarp.

strings.zh: 哦！你有鲤鱼王啊。{NEWLINE}把你最自豪的鲤鱼王{CLEAR}拿给我看看吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh! You have a Magikarp. Show me the{NEWLINE}Magikarp you’re proudest of!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0628/3; modernised from US 0628#3 | RV048: meaning: zh asks for the Magikarp they are proudest of

strings.zh: {VAR:0134:0}.{VAR:0132:1}ｃｍ……！{NEWLINE}{VAR:0134:0}.{VAR:0132:1}ｃｍ的鲤鱼王！！{SCROLL}这个太棒了！{SCROLL}向你的技术致敬！{NEWLINE}作为纪念这个请拿去吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0134:0}.{VAR:0132:1} cm...!{NEWLINE}A {VAR:0134:0}.{VAR:0132:1} cm Magikarp!!{SCROLL}This one is outstanding!{SCROLL}I tip my hat to your skill!{NEWLINE}Take this as a memento!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 不过,主要还是看你的记录,{NEWLINE}奖品你就别太期待了！
strings.en: Still, it’s your record that really{NEWLINE}counts, so don’t expect too{CLEAR}much from the prize!
strings.notes: US 0628/5 | RV048: meaning: zh: don't expect much of the prize

strings.zh: {VAR:0134:0}.{VAR:0132:1}ｃｍ……{SCROLL}本来还想夸你的,{NEWLINE}这条真的不错,{CLEAR}不过之前好像给我{CLEAR}一样大的鲤鱼王吧？
strings.en: {VAR:0134:0}.{VAR:0132:1} cm...{SCROLL}I was about to praise you, since{NEWLINE}this one’s really nice... But didn’t{CLEAR}you already bring me a Magikarp this{CLEAR}size before?

strings.zh: 这个鲤鱼王有{NEWLINE}{VAR:0134:0}.{VAR:0132:1}ｃｍ大~{SCROLL}但我已经看过{VAR:0134:2}.{VAR:0132:3}ｃｍ{NEWLINE}的鲤鱼王了……
strings.en: This Magikarp is {VAR:0134:0}.{VAR:0132:1} cm~{SCROLL}But I’ve already seen a Magikarp that{NEWLINE}was {VAR:0134:2}.{VAR:0132:3} cm...

strings.zh: 什么！{NEWLINE}这个不是鲤鱼王啊！
话说你的背包{NEWLINE}已经满了,装不下了……
strings.en: ...Your Bag is too full!{NEWLINE}Nothing will fit...

strings.zh: 这样啊……{NEWLINE}没有抓到能让我看中的家伙啊。{CLEAR}嗯,下次要给我看更大的。
strings.en: I see... So you haven’t caught one{NEWLINE}that impresses me.{CLEAR}Well, show me a bigger one next time.
strings.notes: US 0628/10 | RV048: omission: bigger-one request restored (D-1993)
